Title: BI DATA ENGINEER
Description:
At Ayesa Digital, we grow with you.




Every professional in our company is essential. Thanks to their talent, we continue to expand: today, we are a global team of more than 11,000 people working toward a shared mission.




Ayesa Digital is currently participating in high-impact European Union projects designed to address major European challenges and drive science and innovation. These strategic technological initiatives stand out for their international scope and strong commitment to socially oriented results.




We are looking for a BI Data Engineer to join our international team and contribute to the creation and maintenance of the Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW) and complex Business Intelligence Solutions (Data Lakes/ Data Lakeshouses).




Key Responsibilities

Design modern Business Intelligence (BI) architectures (e.g., data lakehouse) for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, ensuring compliance with security and data residency requirements.
Gather and analyse business requirements specifically for data pipelines, storage, and reporting solutions.
Design and implement modern Extract, Transform, Load/Extract, Load, Transform (ETL/ELT) processes and orchestration workflows, incorporating data contracts and schema evolution management.
Implement and manage data virtualization layers to provide unified access to heterogeneous data sources while optimizing performance and security.
Design and implement data models (e.g., dimensional modeling) to support reporting and analytics, ensuring alignment with business requirements.
Design and build reporting and analytics applications, creating dashboards, KPIs, and self service BI tools that deliver actionable insights to business stakeholders.
Design and optimize the physical database schema, including indexing, partitioning, and storage strategies, to balance performance, cost, and maintainability.
Conduct ongoing database performance analysis, tuning queries, optimizing resource utilization, and ensuring SLAs for latency and throughput are met.
Design and implement data quality frameworks and health monitoring processes that include data observability (lineage, freshness) and defined Service Level Agreements/Service Level Objectives (SLAs/SLOs).
Define and execute test programs for BI solutions, including data validation, regression tests, contract tests, and automated pipelines integrated into CI/CD.
Produce and maintain technical documentation (data dictionaries, lineage, design specifications, runbooks) to support transparency, governance, and audit readiness.
Perform deployment and configuration of BI systems and platforms, applying infrastructure-as-code, version control, and environment management practices.
Govern the BI semantic layer (KPIs, metrics catalog, naming conventions, row-level security) to ensure consistency and trusted insights.
Manage access controls and data security within BI platforms in alignment with GDPR and internal data protection policies.
Optimize cost and performance of BI platforms and warehouses (partitioning, caching, clustering, query optimization, resource scaling).
Define and enforce data lineage and stewardship practices, ensuring transparency, auditability, and compliance.
Enable self-service BI capabilities for business users through curated datasets, certified reports, and training/support.







What We Are Looking For (Requirements):




Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse design and architecture, including dimensional modelling and star/snowflake schema design.
Knowledge of data lake and lakehouse design patterns (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) to support large-scale analytics.
Excellent knowledge of relational database systems applied to data warehouse.
Knowledge of non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Hadoop HBase) for handling unstructured and semi-structured data.
Excellent knowledge of SQL.
Knowledge of BI reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) for enterprise dashboards and self-service analytics.
Knowledge of ETL and ELT tools (e.g., Informatica, Talend, dbt, Azure Data Factory) to manage enterprise data pipelines.
Knowledge of modelling tools (e.g., ERwin, SAP PowerDesigner, ArchiMate for data flows) to design logical and physical data models.
Knowledge of OLAP technologies (e.g., SSAS, Essbase) and data mining tools (e.g., SAS Enterprise Miner, RapidMiner).
Knowledge of near real-time data ingestion and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Kafka, Debezium, GoldenGate).
Knowledge of cloud BI architectures (e.g., Azure Synapse, Snowflake, AWS Redshift) to enable scalable analytics.
Knowledge of data governance and cataloguing practices (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Azure Purview) to ensure trusted data assets.
Knowledge of data observability practices (e.g., freshness, lineage, anomaly detection) to monitor and assure pipeline quality.
Ability to understand, speak and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.




One of the following or an equivalent certification:

Microsoft Data Analyst Associate.
Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate.
Amazon Certified Data Analytics Specialty.




What We Offer:

Prestigious projects within European institutions.
International, innovative, and multicultural environments.
Continuous support from a team of experts in EU projects.




If you are ambitious, enthusiastic, and seeking a new professional challenge in international projects with real-world impact, this is the place for you!

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies


Experience building scalable data applications using Apache Spark, with proficiency in Scala preferred and Python also acceptable
Hands-on experience working with Databricks in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)
Good understanding of distributed computing, data partitioning, and performance optimisation
Experience working with modern data formats such as Parquet, Delta Lake, and JSON
Strong SQL skills for data transformation and querying
Understanding of graph data structures, clustering techniques, and similarity approaches
Familiarity with statistical methods such as TF-IDF and similarity metrics
Proficiency with version control and build tools including Git, Gradle, Maven, or SBT
Awareness of code quality, maintainability, and testing practices using frameworks such as ScalaTest or JUnit
Experience contributing to testing approaches including unit and integration testing
Ability to use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and support development tasks
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams
Willingness to learn new technologies and develop engineering expertise


Education


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Equivalent practical experience will also be considered


Responsibilities

Support the design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data processing solutions within a scalable data engineering environment


Support the design and development of Spark-based data pipelines for processing large volumes of data
Implement parsing, normalisation, and standardisation logic across datasets
Assist in developing graph-based analytics and entity resolution workflows
Build and maintain ETL workflows ingesting data from sources such as Delta Lake, Parquet, and S3
Contribute to data quality checks, validation, and incremental processing approaches
Write and maintain unit and integration tests to support reliability
Support monitoring and troubleshooting of data pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Data Science, and Engineering
Document data flows and technical solutions
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join an Advanced Analytics team within the retail industry.

You will work on high-impact data and AI initiatives across e-commerce, marketing, customer experience, stores, product, supply chain, and procurement. The role combines traditional Data Science with Generative AI, AI Agents, and MLOps, offering the opportunity to contribute to an ambitious digital retail strategy.

Data Science & Machine Learning

Analyze large and complex datasets using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques.
Identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights to support business decision-making.
Design, build, and deploy predictive and prescriptive ML models.
Develop solutions leveraging Generative AI and AI Agents.
Continuously optimize, fine-tune, and improve model performance.




MLOps & Production

Apply MLOps best practices throughout the machine learning lifecycle.
Implement model versioning, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
Monitor model performance and establish retraining and maintenance processes.
Ensure models are scalable, reliable, and production-ready.




Collaboration & Business Impact

Work closely with data platform teams, data insights teams, and business stakeholders.
Translate business challenges into effective data-driven solutions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Independently lead Data Science projects from concept through delivery.




Innovation & Generative AI

Stay current with developments in Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
Explore new technologies and approaches to strengthen advanced analytics capabilities.
Investigate and implement emerging AI-agent technologies.

Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or another relevant scientific/business discipline.
Minimum 3 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist.
Strong experience with advanced statistics, predictive modelling, and machine learning.
Ability to transform complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly:
Vertex AI
BigQuery
Dataform
Experience with Agentic AI on GCP, such as ADK or Model Armor, is a strong plus.
Understanding of MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).
Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects end-to-end.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with both technical and business stakeholders.
Previous retail or e-commerce experience is a plus.
Fluent English + professional French or Dutch.

Title: Data Analyst – Cloud Migration & BigQuery
Description:
Descrizione Del Lavoro

Our organization is launching a strategic initiative to migrate its data infrastructure from an on-premise Oracle Database environment to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The project involves consolidating legacy data warehouses, re-architecting ETL/ELT pipelines, and adopting cloud-native services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Dataflow.

The selected Data Analyst will be a key contributor across every phase of the migration lifecycle: from as-is data analysis of source systems, through post-migration validation, to supporting business teams in their transition to new cloud-based analytics tools

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Mapping


Inventory and document Oracle source data (schemas, tables, stored procedures, views)
Perform data profiling to identify anomalies, duplicates, and inconsistencies
Define logical data mappings from Oracle to BigQuery for each data domain
Collaborate with data engineers on the definition of transformation rules


Validation & Quality Assurance


Design and implement data reconciliation tests for pre- and post-migration phases
Develop SQL / BigQuery SQL queries to compare source and target datasets
Produce data quality reports covering completeness, accuracy, and consistency metrics
Log and track data anomalies using issue-tracking tools
Strong data modeling skills, including conceptual, logical, and physical design, with hands-on experience in normalization and dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schema).﻿


Migration Support ﻿


Actively participate in sprint planning and stand-ups with technical and business teams
Support the migration of legacy reports into GCP-native tools (Looker, Looker Studio)
Contribute to the definition of data governance standards and cloud best practices
Document data transformation processes for knowledge transfer purposes


Personal Profile & Soft Skills﻿


Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
Ability to communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders
Operational autonomy and a proactive approach to problem-solving
Good time management in multi-task and project-driven environments
Team player: comfortable working in cross-functional IT/Business teams
Flexibility and adaptability in contexts of technological change
Language: Italian Native or Bilingual
Language: English (written and spoken, minimum B2 level)


Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Specialization courses in data engineering, cloud computing, or analytics are a plus

Title: Senior Risk Data Analyst
Description:
Description

About Payliance

Founded in 2007, Payliance is a trusted leader in payment processing — processing more than $63 billion annually, supporting 40,000+ merchant locations, and serving over 350 lending clients. We offer an all-in-one platform for real-time funding, payment processing, account verification, and recovery services, giving lenders the technology to operate efficiently and confidently.

What sets Payliance apart is our blend of modern technology, deep industry expertise, and a highly collaborative, people-first culture. Backed by Serent Capital, we're expanding our capabilities, accelerating innovation, and delivering measurable results for clients across lending, e-commerce, collections, and gaming.

About The Role

The Senior Risk Data Analyst plays a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Payliance's Risk & Compliance organization. You'll develop reporting, analytics, and automation solutions that enhance payments risk monitoring, compliance oversight, and operational efficiency. This role combines strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, and payments domain knowledge to support underwriting, transaction monitoring, compliance testing, and portfolio risk management.

You'll partner with Risk, Compliance, Underwriting, and Operations teams to translate business needs into data-driven solutions, presenting insights and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

What You'll Do

Data Analytics & Reporting


Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reporting for risk and compliance metrics including return rates, unauthorized activity, fraud trends, and chargebacks.
Analyze large transaction datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, and emerging risks.
Produce recurring and ad hoc reporting for leadership and stakeholders to drive visibility and decision-making.


Automation & Technical Enablement


Build and optimize automated workflows, data pipelines, and reporting processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
Partner with Engineering and Product teams to enhance data infrastructure and monitoring capabilities.
Support development of rules engines, alerts, and decisioning tools for transaction monitoring, anomaly detection, and underwriting.


Payments Risk & Compliance Support


Support NACHA return rate monitoring, merchant and originator performance tracking, and compliance KPIs.
Assist the compliance team with QA/testing data analysis, audit support, and regulatory reporting.
Partner with underwriting and risk teams to provide insights into merchant performance and portfolio trends.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Underwriting, and Operations teams to identify data needs and deliver solutions.
Present complex analyses and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Translate business requirements into technical data solutions.


Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: Competitive base commensurate with experience plus annual merit bonus opportunity


Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
401(k) with company match.
Generous PTO plus paid company holidays.
Company-paid life and long-term disability insurance.
Paid parental leave.


Work Environment

Remote — U.S. Collaboration across time zones with occasional travel for team meetings, planning sessions, and company events.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Payliance is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive workplace for everyone. Discrimination or harassment of any kind — based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or pregnancy — is not tolerated. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and employment process.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or related).
7+ years of experience in data analytics, risk analytics, or financial services analytics.
Strong proficiency working with large datasets and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Grafana, or similar).
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
Understanding of payments data and risk indicators.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services.
Familiarity with ACH/NACHA rules or transaction monitoring.
Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, or similar data manipulation languages.
Experience with data pipeline tools and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of fraud detection, risk modeling, or compliance analytics.


How Your Success Will Be Measured


Data Quality & Accuracy: Reliability of dashboards and reporting; support for accurate decision-making by leadership.
Insight Generation: Ability to identify trends, patterns, and emerging risks through analytics that drive action.
Operational Efficiency: Reduction in manual reporting tasks through automation; faster turnaround on ad hoc requests.
Compliance Support: Effectiveness in supporting audit, testing, and regulatory reporting efforts.
Technical Improvements: Successful implementation of new tools, processes, or automation that enhance capabilities.
Stakeholder Satisfaction: Feedback from Risk, Compliance, and Underwriting teams on responsiveness and solution quality.

Job Description

Data Analyst

Location: Zurich (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time

Department: BFSI2





Job Summary

eClerx is seeking a Data Analyst to support one of our leading global financial services clients. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity and governance of critical reference data, including Legal Entity (LEM) IDs and Industry Codes, while supporting data quality remediation initiatives across multiple business functions.

Working closely with global Operations, Technology, Change, and Data teams, you will identify, investigate and resolve data quality issues, maintain documentation, monitor production processes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and data accuracy.

Responsibilities


Ensure the accurate population and ongoing maintenance of Legal Entity (LEM) IDs and Industry Codes for in-scope clients.
Develop a strong understanding of the underlying data model and support data quality remediation programmes to resolve identified issues.
Partner with global teams to deliver excellent client service and seamless operational support.
Continuously monitor production processes to identify exceptions, anomalies and potential data quality issues in real time.
Investigate, analyse and resolve data discrepancies across multiple databases, applications and operational systems.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of front-to-back architecture, data remediation methodologies, processes and outcomes.
Collaborate with Technology, Data Owners, Change teams and other stakeholders to develop and implement effective data remediation strategies.
Generate regular and standardised reports covering data quality metrics, remediation activities and progress against data quality objectives.
Support reporting, analytics and management information requirements for key stakeholders.
Identify opportunities for process optimisation, automation and continuous improvement.
Work closely with Change teams to define and implement process improvement initiatives.
Adhere to internal operational controls, procedures and governance standards while ensuring high levels of data quality and accuracy.


Eligibility Requirements


Ideally 1–5 years of experience in Data Management, Reference Data, Operations, Middle Office, Collateral Management or a similar Financial Services environment.
Good understanding of data quality management, data governance and operational processes within financial services.
Previous experience in Operations, Collateral Management or ISDA Documentation would be advantageous.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail and a robust control mindset.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.
Good understanding of front-to-back operational processes and the impact of data across the organisation.
Experience working with global teams in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.
Experience using reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Qlik would be highly advantageous.
Ability to work effectively under pressure while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics or a related discipline is preferred.
Fluent in English and/or German.
Swiss work permit or EU passport required.


What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is highly analytical, detail-oriented and proactive, with a strong control mindset and a passion for data quality. The ideal candidate enjoys investigating complex data issues, collaborating with global stakeholders and driving continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining exceptional levels of accuracy.

If you enjoy solving data challenges, improving operational processes and contributing to high-quality service delivery within a global financial services environment, we'd love to hear from you.

How To Apply


Click "Apply Now" to submit your resume through our career site
Be sure to include any relevant experience that aligns with the role.
Qualified candidates will be contacted by a member of our recruitment team for next steps


About EClerx

eClerx is a leading provider of productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results.

The firm provides business process management, automation, and analytics services to a number of Fortune 2000 enterprises, including some of the world’s leading financial services, communications, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, and technology companies. Incorporated in 2000, eClerx is traded on both the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges of India. The firm employs more than 19,000 people across Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Switzerland, Egypt. India, Italy, Netherlands, Peru, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, the UK, and the USA.

Let’s talk about the role!

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Associate to join our EMEA Business Intelligence team.




This role is ideal for someone with a foundational understanding of data analytics and business intelligence who is eager to grow their technical and functional skills in a collaborative environment. The successful candidate will support the maintenance and enhancement of Data & Analytics solutions while working closely with senior team members and business stakeholders.

Support the development and maintenance of ETL processes using tools such as SAP BODS, SQL Server, and Visual Studio
Hands on SQL, SAP HANA, Databricks, Power BI, Genie AI, IBM Cognos
Help monitor and maintain existing data solutions and pipelines
Participate in the analysis of current BI and analytics platforms to identify improvement opportunities
Contribute to technical and functional documentation for Data initiatives and migration projects
Work with business users and technical teams to understand requirements and support the delivery of BI solutions
Monitor scheduled jobs and escalate issues when necessary
Support implementation and adoption of Data AI solutions
Support cloud migration initiatives




Skills For Success

Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Familiarity with data warehousing and ETL concepts
Exposure to SAP HANA, SAP BODS, SQL Server, Databricks, Power BI or similar technologies is considered a plus
Familiarity with Cognitive AI concept and products
Ability to document processes and technical solutions clearly and accurately
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to understand business processes and translate business requirements into scalable technology and data solutions
Good attention to detail and willingness to learn new technologies
Effective communication, teamwork and proactiveness skills
English fluency, both written and spoken, is mandatory

Academic background in scientific or quantitative disciplines is mandatory
Up to 2 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field, preferably within multinational and international business environments.
Experience through internships, academic projects, or professional roles involving data analysis or reporting
Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Agile methodology

Title: Customer Leads Analyst - Switzerland
Description:
Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra-luxury brand.

Role

The Customer Leads Analystm, based in the Switzerland Corporate Office drives Aman’s customer segmentation and data-led lead generation across all lines of business. This role leverages analytics, segmentation, and data modeling to identify, qualify, and optimize high-potential leads across Aman’s portfolio. This role partners closely with Residential Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Data Platforms to manage prospect flows, CRM profile management, evaluate conversion performance, and build predictive scoring models that improve acquisition and targeting efficiency, and delivers rich data sets to respective LOBs for downstream activation. Critically, it also researches, sources, evaluates, and integrates new external sources of data, including real estate, demographic, and wealth data sets to enrich lead intelligence and support global customer acquisition and retention.

Responsibilities:


Write and optimize SQL queries to prepare, transform, and analyze guest data from multiple sources to answer population and segment questions from Residential Sales & Marketing
Automate and scale reporting outputs to enable faster, insight-led decision-making
Execute Aman’s data-driven lead generation and scoring strategy for Residential properties
Identify high-value prospect segments through data modeling, clustering, and behavioral analysis
Develop KPIs and dashboards to track lead quality, pipeline progression, and conversion performance

Description:
Merci de postuler selon les modalités mentionnées sur l'annonce (rendez-vous sur www.vd.ch/offres-demploi). Les profils partagés via LinkedIn ne seront pas traités.




Description de l'emploi

En qualité d’analyste de données, vous êtes responsable de mener les études et les analyses statistiques sur des thèmes RH, d'assurer la réalisation de simulations et de projections sur les données du personnel.




Responsabilités

Accompagner les services et la DGRH dans la mise en œuvre d’une bonne gouvernance des données, notamment en matière de processus, de saisie, de contrôle et de qualité, avec un accompagnement adapté aux besoins.

Pour de plus amples informations, veuillez consulter le cahier des charges ici ou contacter Monsieur Bruno Bonafonte, Directeur prospective et organisations au 021 316 19 42.

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to bring real transparency to how our product and marketing efforts are performing. You'll build the reporting that shows what's actually happening across the customer journey, and help the team understand whether new features and initiatives are delivering what they promised.




This is a remote role. Most of the team is based in Switzerland, so we're looking for meaningful overlap with Central European working hours and comfort working in English, our team's working language.


Tasks


What You'll Do





Build and maintain dashboards and reporting across the full customer journey, covering acquisition, activation, conversion, engagement, retention, transactions, and drop-off points


Define KPI definitions, calculation methodology, ownership, and reporting frequency, and work with Technology to keep the underlying tracking solid


Monitor product, marketing, and funnel KPIs on an ongoing basis, and flag unusual trends, risks, and performance gaps early, with context on likely causes


Distinguish short-term fluctuations from structural issues, and run regular performance reviews with Product, Marketing, Technology, and leadership


Connect product and marketing KPIs to broader business objectives such as GMV, active users, conversion, and retention, and help leadership prioritise where to focus


Define success metrics, baselines, and evaluation periods before new features and initiatives launch


Track adoption, usage, and business impact after launch, and give a clear, evidence-based read on whether an initiative delivered


Turn analysis into practical, prioritised recommendations for Product, Marketing, and Technology


Help teams design experiments and determine how their impact should be measured





Who You'll Work With




You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Product Management day to day. You'll also partner regularly with the Head of Marketing and the Marketing team, and the Head of Technology and the Technology team, keeping Operations and leadership in the loop on your insights and recommendations.


Requirements


What You'll Need





Several years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or business intelligence, ideally at a digital product, marketplace, fintech, or platform business


A track record of building dashboards, defining KPIs, and measuring the impact of features and campaigns


Strong command of funnel, cohort, retention, and segmentation analysis


Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase, and product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Google Analytics


Good SQL skills, so you can pull and analyse your own data independently


Ability to turn data into a clear business recommendation, and a solid grasp of what drives the business, including GMV, activation, conversion, retention, and LTV


Confidence to challenge assumptions when the data tells a different story


Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical stakeholders


A proactive, structured, and independent way of working, comfortable operating with incomplete data and shifting priorities





Nice to Have





Experience with A/B testing and statistical evaluation


Experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery


Familiarity with using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to speed up analytical work



Benefits


What We Offer





High visibility with leadership, your analysis and recommendations feed directly into real business decisions


Cross-functional exposure from day one, working closely with Product, Marketing, and Technology


Real ownership over how performance reporting and analytics get built at the company


Remote flexibility, with a closely connected, Switzerland-based core team





Scope of the Role




This role owns reporting transparency, KPI definitions, performance analysis, impact measurement, and recommendations. It is not accountable for implementing fixes: product delivery, campaign execution, technology implementation, and operational changes remain with the relevant functional leads.




If you enjoy turning data into clarity and want a role where your analysis genuinely shapes decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Flight Test Data Analyst
Description:
Über uns

Skysec Defence ist ein Schweizer Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung modernster C-UAS (Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Lösungen spezialisiert hat.

Mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Software-, Elektronik-, System- und Entwicklungsingenieuren arbeiten wir an der Spitze der Drohnentechnologie und entwickeln Systeme, die neue Massstäbe in der Luftabwehr setzen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Flight-Testing-Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Flight Test Data Analyst.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit Daten aus realen Flugversuchen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme.

Deine Analysen bilden die Grundlage für nachvollziehbare Testberichte, fundierte technische Entscheidungen und die Verbesserung unserer Systemmodelle. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du den Aufbau eines digitalen Zwillings, der zukünftig eine zentrale Rolle in Simulation, Entwicklung und Validierung einnehmen wird.

Wir suchen eine analytisch starke Persönlichkeit, die aus komplexen Messdaten klare Erkenntnisse gewinnt und diese in verlässliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen übersetzt.

Anforderungen

Das bringst du mit


Aus- und Weiterbildung: Du verfügst über einen Masterabschluss in Data Science, Aerospace Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Physik, Mathematik, Statistik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet.
Berufserfahrung: Du hast in technischen Projekten die Datenanalyse durchgeführt.
Fundierte Datenanalysekenntnisse: Du hast Erfahrung in der strukturierten Aufbereitung, Analyse und Interpretation komplexer technischer Datensätze.
Programmierkenntnisse: Du kannst Datenanalysen mit geeigneten Programmiersprachen und Werkzeugen selbstständig umsetzen und automatisieren.
Weitere Skills: Qualitätsbewusstsein, analytische Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigenverantwortung und technisches Verständnis
Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kannst Analyseergebnisse sowohl für technische Fachpersonen als auch für weitere Projektbeteiligte klar und verständlich aufbereiten.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Engagement: Du identifizierst dich mit der Mission und den Zielen von Skysec Defence, übernimmst Ownership und bist bereit, dich mit hohem Einsatz für zuverlässige Abläufe und erfolgreiche Einsätze einzubringen.


Angebot

Was wir dir bieten


Motivierendes Umfeld


Flache Hierarchien, klare Ziele und moderne Technologie


Flexible Arbeitszeiten


Gleitarbeitszeit für eine gute Work-Life-Balance


Zukunftstechnologie


Arbeite an der Drohnentechnologie von morgen mit


Bezahlte Zertifizierungen


Drohnenprüfungen, Erneuerungen und relevante Weiterbildungen werden unterstützt


Innovation wird gefördert


Deine Ideen sind willkommen und werden aktiv weiterverfolgt


Gratis Kaffee


Bester Kaffee der Kaffeerösterei Küng, kostenlos für alle


Fitness-Abo


Vergünstigtes Fitness-Abo direkt neben dem Büro


Attraktive Konditionen


Attraktive Vergütung und wachsende Sozialleistungen


Team-Events


Regelmässige Teamevents, Apéros und gemeinsame Essen

Bereit, mit uns die Drohnentechnologie der Zukunft zu gestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Title: Customer Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome to GenTwo

GenTwo is a global financial engineering company enabling the creation, issuance, and lifecycle management of innovative investment products. With our state-of-the-art platform and securitization infrastructure, we empower financial institutions, asset managers, and professional investors to bring new investment ideas to market faster, more efficiently, and without traditional constraints.

We are a Series-B-stage company with global ambitions, serving clients in more than 25 countries. We value clarity, ownership, and people who thrive in complexity.




Our core values

Stronger Together
Create Clarity
I Own It
Figure It Out




Location: Zurich, Switzerland

Department: CRM & Data Insights

Employment Type: Full-time




Who you are:




As a Customer Data Specialist, you don’t just pull the numbers - you make them worth trusting. You keep CRM data clean, processes well-governed, and every number traceable to its source. You’re comfortable connecting the dots across CRM, GTM systems, and campaign data, and just as confident explaining what the numbers mean to leadership.

If you want to own the data layer that powers how a fast-growing fintech goes to market, let’s talk!




Your tasks & responsibilities:




You turn data into decisions: You analyse campaign performance, conversion rates, pipeline quality, and translate what you find into recommendations people act on.
You build the reporting layer: Dashboards that are accurate, self-refreshing, and built on KPI definitions everyone has agreed to.
You make the business self-sufficient: You resolve advanced reporting requests fast, and reduce the next one through governed self-service, documentation, and a bit of training.
You own CRM: You make sure our workflows meet business needs, and that permissions, integrations, and configurations stay aligned with how the business sells. You're also the first call when something breaks.
You guard data quality: You keep customer acquisition data complete, accurate, and consistent across HubSpot and the tools around it. When something drifts out of line, you spot it early, get to the bottom of it, and fix it with the stakeholders involved, at the source wherever that's possible.
You use AI where it makes sense: You know where AI can simplify repetitive work and improve efficiency, and where it adds unnecessary complexity. You apply it thoughtfully to solve real business problems.




What you bring:




3–5 years in customer analytics, revenue/marketing operations, or BI, ideally in fintech, SaaS, or a similarly fast-moving environment.
Hands-on HubSpot/Salesforce experience, including admin and workflow work.
Strong reporting and analytics skills, including hands-on Power BI experience and working with data across multiple sources, systems, and channels. Familiarity with data warehouse or lakehouse concepts is a plus.
You’re confident working with stakeholders across the business, translating their needs into data solutions and explaining findings in a clear, actionable way.
You already use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about where they go next.
Fluent in English; Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship required.




What we offer:




A high-impact role in a growing, international fintech - you own the data foundation our entire GTM engine runs on and build it out.
Company-wide AI tooling at your disposal from day one.
Hybrid working with regular home office days.
A central office in the heart of Zurich.




What the process looks like:




If you're still reading, we're guessing you're interested. Here's what happens next:

Send us your application, including your CV, references, and diplomas.
Join an online chat with our People & Culture Manager.
Meet the hiring manager, complete a live case study, and connect with key stakeholders during the final conversations.




Disclaimer: Legitimate recruiting outreach from GenTwo will always come through verified channels. We will never ask candidates to communicate via SMS or WhatsApp.

About The Team

eBay is the #1 Collectibles marketplace in the world, selling to millions of customers globally. Our mission is to be the most loved destination for collectors of trading cards, memorabilia, toys, comics, coins, and more. To accomplish this, we put our collectors first and innovate tirelessly to optimize experiences across our platform.

eBay Collectibles is looking for an EU Inventory Insights Manager to drive deep understanding of where to play and how to win within the broad and diverse collectibles market. This analytics pro will leverage data to advise where we focus incentives, seller acquisition efforts, buyer programming, retention/loyalty, and where we should execute our strategy across the entire EU collectibles portfolio. This role’s remit encompasses critical analytics work that will inform strategy and operational day-to-day decision making within one of eBay's most passionate and rapidly expanding categories. The ideal candidate will possess a complete analytical toolkit including how to synthesize data into actionable strategic and operational insights.

eBay would not be what it is today without our amazing employees -– from Inventory Insights leaders to Customer Support and everyone in between. We take great pride in hiring and developing top talent who can add to our culture and believe in our mission. eBay is an exciting opportunity to harness a growth mindset and engage with a passionate community of enthusiasts, fostering a vibrant and dynamic marketplace.

About The Role

This is a critical analytics role for the European Collectibles team, whose charter is to grow the category by continuing to make eBay a trusted and top-of-mind destination for Collectors. We are looking for someone to enable strategy execution. You will support initiatives ranging from analyzing data to understanding what is eBay’s next focus area to optimizing existing operations. You will also partner with the category managers within EU Collectibles, the wider global Collectibles teams, the Product and Technology teams, and other business teams on different initiatives. This role requires someone who has the technical skills to extract and analyze data as well as develop visualizations to communicate insights in an easily digestible way.

Responsibilities


Extract data and derive data-driven insights to inform decision making
Support development of A/B tests related to buyer and seller trust, behavior, and inventory velocity
Build reporting dashboards and scorecards
Support data needs for operating and strategic discussions with the Collectibles leadership team
Support the development of executive-ready presentations on strategy and operational updates
Work cross-functionally with peer analytics partners to develop comprehensive tools and business recommendations



Qualifications

Experience:

5 -7 years in analytics

Technical Requirements


Advanced SQL coding (+ demonstrated expertise working with and pulling data from Data Warehouse)
Advanced MS Excel
Demonstrated expertise developing and updating scorecards / dashboards in Tableau and MS Excel
Proficient in MS Powerpoint and Google Presentations



Other Requirements/differentiators


Able to thoughtfully apply detailed logic and methods to solve problems and enable decision making
Able to build constructive and effective relationships with a broad and diverse group of business partners
Track record of presenting ideas and directions to influence others into taking desired actions
Able to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into concrete information to get results
Strong communications, including the ability to tell a compelling story backed by data
Desire to engage with customers directly and passionate about helping eBay win!

Title: Transactional Revenue Intelligence & Systems Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Transactional Revenue Intelligence & Systems Analyst based in Switzerland.

This role offers the opportunity to turn customer, market, and operational data into measurable business outcomes.

You will act as a hands-on operator, building dashboards, decision systems, workflows, and campaigns that help teams move faster and make better decisions.

The position sits at the intersection of revenue, customer insight, transactions, product, and operational improvement.

You will investigate ambiguous business problems, connect structured and unstructured data, and translate findings into practical recommendations.

Your work will help identify growth opportunities, improve customer behavior, strengthen digital transactions, and remove internal bottlenecks.

You will also use automation, research, analytics, and emerging tools to create scalable ways of working.

This is an independent, high-ownership opportunity for someone who combines analytical rigor with commercial curiosity and a strong bias toward action.

Accountabilities


Build and maintain dashboards, reporting tools, and decision-support systems for Revenue, Transactions, Customer Success, Product, and leadership teams.
Translate business questions into reliable decision frameworks by defining problems, identifying relevant evidence, and measuring outcomes.
Combine customer calls, feedback, email interactions, market research, and other data sources to understand purchasing, listing, and selling behaviors.
Identify patterns, trends, risks, and opportunities across customers and use these insights to recommend process, product, or integration improvements.
Support marketplace growth by helping customers improve sourcing, catalog reliability, and digital sales activity.
Design, launch, and execute scalable campaigns that make digital buying and selling easier across the ecosystem.
Create feedback loops to measure whether campaigns, product changes, and new initiatives improve adoption, transaction volume, efficiency, or other business outcomes.
Monitor data quality, investigate inconsistencies, and ensure dashboards and analytical outputs are accurate and trustworthy.
Turn customer and market insights into clear evidence that can inform product priorities, enablement, and commercial decisions.
Identify internal bottlenecks and improve workflows through automation, better processes, and scalable systems.
Use research, prototyping, automation, and data analysis tools to accelerate problem-solving while applying human judgment where customer context requires it.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders, helping teams act on insights rather than simply consume reports.


Requirements


Strong analytical judgment and commercial curiosity, with the ability to connect data to practical business outcomes.
Experience solving ambiguous business problems using data, spreadsheets, SQL, programming, or comparable analytical tools.
Ability to work confidently with both structured and unstructured data from multiple sources.
Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear, useful narratives for non-technical and cross-functional audiences.
Experience building dashboards, analytical tools, reporting systems, or decision-support solutions that enable teams to take action.
A practical understanding of automation, workflow optimization, research, and data-driven experimentation.
Ability to independently define problems, identify appropriate inputs, develop solutions, and measure results without extensive direction.
Interest in marketplaces, B2B SaaS, revenue operations, customer behavior, and operational systems.
A continuous-improvement mindset, with the humility and rigor to surface uncertainty, challenge assumptions, and improve systems rather than defend an initial hypothesis.
Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Experience in the floriculture industry is considered a strong advantage.


Benefits


Full-time opportunity within a fast-growing international organization.
Flexible, remote-first working environment with the ability to work independently.
High level of ownership and autonomy over analytical systems, campaigns, and business improvement initiatives.
Opportunity to collaborate with teams across the Americas and Europe.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Financial support for technical certifications and other learning initiatives.
Competitive salary with compensation negotiable based on experience.
Indefinite employment contract.
Opportunity to make a measurable impact across revenue, customer success, product, and marketplace operations.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Ihr Profil


Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss (FH oder Universität) in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet oder über eine gleichwertige Qualifikation.
Sie bringen mindestens drei bis fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Business-Intelligence-Lösungen mit.

Title: Data & Reporting Specialist (FAP-BC-DL-2026-203-GRAE)
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data, problem-solving, and turning complex information into clear insights? Do you enjoy maintaining and improving data systems, from legacy databases to modern reporting platforms? Join our agile, self-organised team of engineers to help maintain and develop CERN's Corporate Information Systems! Take Part! You'll be part of the Business Computing (BC) group, supporting Finance and Procurement.

Your mission: analyse, improve, and help modernise reporting and data solutions, while supporting the transformation of CERN's enterprise systems and ensuring that future analytics needs are properly understood and addressed.

Your responsibilities:


Extract, transform, model, and visualise data in reports, dashboards, and analytics platforms;
Interact with relational databases, mainly Oracle, using SQL and PL/SQL;
Develop, maintain, and test reporting data models and semantic models supporting CERN's Finance and Procurement systems;
Maintain, support, and enhance existing reporting and data solutions while helping define and implement their future evolution;
Contribute to data profiling, mapping, quality checks, validation, and reconciliation activities during migration and transition phases;
Contribute to the development and maintenance of ETL/ELT pipelines and other data-processing activities where required;
Collaborate with business users, functional experts, architects, and developers to ensure data consistency, usability, and technical feasibility;
Support testing, troubleshooting, documentation, maintenance, and third-level support for reporting and data solutions.


Your profile:

Data Analysis & Reporting:


Experience in SQL (writing, optimising, debugging complex queries).
Familiarity with data visualisation or analytics tools such as Power BI, R, or Python-based dashboards.
Understanding of data modelling principles (dimensional/star schema design, semantic models, data warehouses).
Experience analysing data structures, flows, and dependencies in complex enterprise systems.


Data Engineering:


Exposure to data pipeline concepts and tools such as SQL, dbt, Airflow, or Python for data processing.
Interest in maintaining and modernising reporting and data solutions during a systems transformation.


Business Processes & User Support:


Interest in providing end-user support, troubleshooting, escalation, and issue resolution.
Awareness of Finance and Procurement processes or interest in learning about business domains.


Collaboration:


Experience working in group projects, ideally in collaborative or Agile environments.


Skills:

Data & Analytics:


Excellent knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Knowledge of data visualisation and analytics tools, particularly Power BI.
Ability to contribute to the design and maintenance of data models for reporting and analytics.
Ability to understand and document complex data structures, data flows, dependencies, and transformation logic.


Data Governance & Quality:


Awareness of data quality, security, and governance concepts.
Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.


Technical Environment:


Knowledge of version control systems and basic interaction with Linux servers via the command line.
Knowledge of Agile practices and experience maintaining reporting solutions and data pipelines in an agile environment.
Comfortable in working with both new and legacy systems.


Communication & Collaboration:


Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex information effectively.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:


You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree.
You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.


Additional Information

Job closing date: 30.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-November-2026

This position involves:


Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: FAP-BC-DL-2026-203-GRAE

Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics

Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits


A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.
30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
On-the-job and formal training including language classes.


Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

More information about us, here: careers.cern

Title: Data & Reporting Specialist 80-100% (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir bewegen und begeistern Menschen. Einfach. Nachhaltig. Voraus.

Mit über 90 Standorten schweizweit steht die AMAG Retail in direktem Endkundenkontakt und umfasst alle AMAG Garagenbetriebe, Carosserie Center und Occassions Center.

Du bist die Brücke zwischen Daten und Entscheidungen.

Als Reporting & Power BI Specialist verwandelst du Daten aus SAP, CRM und Microsoft Fabric in klare, verlässliche Reports für Controlling, Sales, Aftersales, Finance und Marketing.

Du bist dabei nicht nur Entwickler/-in, sondern Data Storyteller und strategische/-r Partner/-in der Fachbereiche.

Wie wir dich begeistern


Life long learning: Wir beteiligen uns an deiner Weiterbildung – booste deine Karriere!
Flexibilität leben: Vereinbare Familie, Hobby und Beruf – geniesse die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens
ZIF: Zusätzliche individuelle Freitage – Kaufe dir zusätzliche Urlaubstage und gönne dir eine wohlverdiente längere Auszeit
Ganzheitliches Mobilitätskonzept: Parkhaus, Car-Sharing und eine E-Bike-Flotte – alles, was du für deinen Weg zur Arbeit brauchst
Spezialkonditionen bei Fahrzeugkauf und Service: Für dich und deine Familie – weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Mobilität ist


Was du bei uns bewegen kannst


End‑to‑End Reporting: Du konzipierst, entwickelst und deployest Power‑BI‑Reports und Dashboards über den gesamten Reporting‑Lifecycle hinweg und stellst deren nachhaltigen Betrieb sicher
Business Partnering: Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachbereichen Controlling, Sales, Aftersales, Marketing und Finance zusammen, nimmst Anforderungen auf und übersetzt diese in tragfähige Reporting‑ und Analytics‑Lösungen
Data Storytelling & Analytics: Du verwandelst komplexe Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen in klare, verständliche Insights, identifizierst relevante Geschäftsfragestellungen und leitest datenbasierte Optimierungspotenziale ab
Governance & Qualität: Du stellst eine hohe Daten‑ und Reporting‑Qualität sicher, definierst und etablierst Standards, verantwortest die Dokumentation sowie die Versions‑ und Deployment‑Prozesse
Enablement & Zusammenarbeit: Du befähigst Key User zu Self‑Service BI (inkl. Power BI und Copilot) und förderst die effiziente Zusammenarbeit zwischen internen und externen Partnern


Das bringst du mit


Aus- und Weiterbildung: Technische oder kaufmännische Grundausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch Studium/Weiterbildung in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder BWL
Berufserfahrung & Business-Verständnis: Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Finanz‑/Controlling‑Umfeld, idealerweise mit Projekterfahrung und Branchenkenntnissen
Daten‑ & BI‑Expertise: Fundierte Erfahrung in Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric sowie in der strukturierten Datenaufbereitung
Technische Skills: Sehr gute SQL‑Kenntnisse (z. B. Azure SQL, Fabric Warehouse, SAP‑Extrakte) und solides technisches Verständnis
Analytische Persönlichkeit & Kommunikation: Analytischer Mindset, Freude an Daten und Insights, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Französischkenntnisse


Denkst du, dass wir zusammenpassen könnten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Übrigens: Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Hast du Fragen zur Stelle oder zum Bewerbungsprozess? Dann kontaktiere mich doch einfach per WhatsApp Kurznachricht. Informationen zum Datenschutz findest du in unseren Datenschutzbestimmungen.

In this role, you will develop, implement and maintain processes, programs to ensure compliance with existing and emerging chemical control legislations.

Sounds interesting? It could well be your perfect opportunity if, like us, you always aim to exceed customer needs, deliver value and are skilled at fostering strong relationships.

Title: Sales Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a motivated Sales Analyst to join our growing team in the Sales Department. This role is ideal for young individuals who are interested in sustainable energy, data analysis, and commercial development. You will support the sales team by analyzing market trends, customer data, pricing conditions, and sales performance to drive data-backed decision-making.

Main Duties And Responsibilities


Assist in collecting, organizing, and analyzing sales data, customer profiles, and market insights.
Conduct thorough research and monitor biofuel market trends, including pricing, supply-demand indicators, regulatory changes, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and presentations to support sales planning and forecasting.
Support sales managers with customer quotations, pricing analysis, and contract administrative tasks.
Identify and profile key stakeholders in the biofuel ecosystem, including airlines, aircraft manufacturers, government agencies, and environmental organizations.
Stay updated on biofuel-related regulations, incentives, and policies that may impact the market and customer behavior.
Work closely with cross-functional teams (operations, logistics, finance) to ensure data accuracy and timely information flow.
Prepare and present research findings, insights, and recommendations to internal stakeholders, including management and product development teams.
Assist in developing CRM updates, pipeline tracking, and sales performance metrics.
Participate in ad hoc analysis and projects to support commercial strategy.


Qualifications And Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Environmental Science, Energy Management, or related disciplines.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret data effectively.
Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with data tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, or CRM systems) is an advantage.
Interest in renewable fuel, sustainability principles, or commodities markets is highly preferred.
Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.
A passion for environmental sustainability and a commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions in the aviation sector.
Fresh graduates are welcome; relevant internship experience is a plus.


EcoCeres is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. EcoCeres is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Title: (Senior) Data Analytics Consultant 60-100%
Description:
Eraneos ist eine internationale Beratungsgruppe für Strategie, Transformation und Technologie, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, in einer dynamischen digitalen Welt erfolgreich zu sein. Mit erstklassigen Expertinnen und Experten aus Business und Technologie befähigen wir unsere Kunden, neue Massstäbe für nachhaltige Transformationen zu setzen – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Ob bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen, der Erschliessung neuer Potenziale durch Daten und KI oder der Absicherung von Unternehmen durch ganzheitliche Cybersicherheit: Wir liefern Resultate pragmatisch und zielgerichtet. Unser Team von rund 1‘200 engagierten Mitarbeitenden ist in Büros in der Schweiz, Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Spanien, Dänemark, Schweden, Österreich, Grossbritannien, Singapur und den USA vertreten und verbindet globale Perspektiven mit starken lokalen Wurzeln. An den Schweizer Standorten Zürich, Bern und Lausanne arbeiten rund 460 Mitarbeitende.




Das ist der Job




In unserem Team von rund 50 Data & AI-Berater:innen in der Schweiz arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kunden an spannenden Projekten, um mit quantitativen Methoden ihre Herausforderungen zu lösen. Der Wissensaustausch in der Community sowie das aktive Mitgestalten unserer wachsenden Data & AI-Services gehören für dich selbstverständlich dazu. International profitierst du von einem Netzwerk mit über 200 Expert:innen.

Beratung unserer Kunden zu Fragestellungen rund um Data Analytics, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungsunterstützung.
Analyse geschäftlicher Herausforderungen und Entwicklung praxisnaher Analytics- und Reporting-Konzepte.
Konzeption und Umsetzung skalierbarer Reporting- und Analytics-Lösungen entlang moderner Datenarchitekturen.
Mitarbeit in Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Rollen – von der Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zu Engineering-, Implementierungs- oder Projektleitungsaufgaben.
Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Data & AI Beratungsportfolios sowie Unterstützung bei der Akquise neuer Projekte.




Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn

du Freude daran hast, komplexe Probleme strukturiert zu analysieren und datenbasierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.
du fundierte Kenntnisse in Data-Analytics-Methoden, Datenarchitekturen und Reporting-Lösungen mitbringst.
Themen wie Datenqualität, Data Governance, saubere ETL/ELT-Prozesse und IBCS-konformes Reporting für dich selbstverständlich sind.
du praktische Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Datenanalyse und Datenvisualisierung gesammelt hast.
du sicher mit gängigen Analytics-Tools arbeitest, z. B. Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, Qlik Sense oder SAP Analytics Cloud.
du gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitest und komplexe Inhalte verständlich vermitteln kannst.
du über Beratungs- oder Projekterfahrung verfügst und eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst.
du einen Masterabschluss in einer quantitativen Disziplin besitzt, z. B. Data Science, Mathematik, Physik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Informatik.
du Deutsch und Englisch jeweils auf mindestens C1-Niveau beherrschst und sicher mit Kunden sowie Projektteams kommunizieren kannst.




Auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – entscheidend sind für uns dein Potenzial, deine Haltung und dein Verständnis für datengetriebene Lösungen.




Als i-Tüpfelchen bringst du mit

Zertifizierungen in Analytics- oder Cloud-Technologien (z. B. Microsoft, Tableau, Qlik, AWS oder GCP).
Programmiererfahrung in Python, SQL, M-Code oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
Erfahrung mit modernen Datenplattformen wie Snowflake oder Databricks.
Kenntnisse in Cloud-Architekturen (Azure, AWS oder GCP).
Erfahrung mit agilen Projektmethoden wie Scrum oder SAFe.




Dein nächster Schritt zur erfolgreichen Bewerbung

Hüseyin als deine Ansprechperson freut sich auf deine Direktbewerbung über unsere Webseite (Lebenslauf, Diplome und Arbeitszeugnisse in PDF).




Diversity wird bei uns grossgeschrieben – wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung!

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d) im Reportingbereich
Description:
Ihre Rolle in unserem Team

Als Data Scientist (m/w/d) treiben Sie die datengetriebene Entscheidungsfindung in unserem Unternehmen voran. Sie konzipieren und entwickeln neue Datenprodukte für unseren Servicebereich, insbesondere für ein gruppenweites Reporting. Perspektivisch unterstützen Sie zudem die Organisationsentwicklung durch die Einführung und Nutzung von Process-Mining-Tools zur Prozessanalyse und -optimierung. Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie weitere datenbezogene Entwicklungsinitiativen und liefern mit Ihren Analysen wertvolle Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Ihre Arbeit stärkt eine Kultur des Datendenkens und macht datengesteuerte Services umsetzbar, wodurch Sie einen direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des gesamten Unternehmens haben.

Verantwortlichkeiten



Konzeption und Entwicklung von Datenmodellen auf Basis von SAP Datasphere
Erstellung von Analyse-Dashboards und Reports mit definierten KPIs in der SAP Analytics Cloud sowie Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen
Umsetzung, Dokumentation und Einführung der entwickelten Datenmodelle
Steuerung datengetriebener Projekte und Initiativen als Projekt- oder Programmmanager:in
Aufbau und Einführung eines Process-Mining-Tools für Root-Cause-Analysen



Ihr Profil



Sie haben abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
Sie begeistern sich für Daten, Analysen und Prozesse und besitzen ein ausgeprägtes konzeptionelles Denkvermögen
Sie verfügen über starke technische Fähigkeiten und können komplexe Geschäftsprobleme strukturiert lösen
Sie verstehen den geschäftlichen Kontext und besitzen die Fähigkeit den möglichen Einsatz von Datenanalysen zur Verbesserung von Abläufen zu erkennen
Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse von Methoden und Modellen der Datenanalyse
Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen und haben Erfahrung mit Datenbanken sowie Datenvisualisierungstools
Sie besitzen gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL sowie Erfahrung mit SAP; Kenntnisse in Python sind von Vorteil
Sie sind in der Lage die Erkenntnisse Ihrer Arbeit verständlich, adressatengerecht und überzeugend gegenüber den Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren



Ihre Vorteile



Sie arbeiten in einem internationalen, kollaborativen und angenehmen Arbeitsumfeld
Sinnvolle und herausfordernde Aufgaben in einer schnell wachsenden Branche
Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur weiteren Entwicklung
Ein Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – vertrauliche Beratung und Unterstützung bei gesundheitlichen, beruflichen und persönlichen Herausforderungen
Attraktives Vergütungspaket

Title: Wholesale Analyst
Description:
We are currently looking for Wholesale Analyst (English/French) within our Wholesale department based in Geneva (Switzerland).




Contract type: Permanent

Location : Geneva, Switzerland

Start date: October 2026




Overview and purpose of role:

Under the Supervision of the EMEI Wholesale, Franchise and Global Etailer Director, The Wholesale Analyst plays a key role in supporting the growth and success of the EMEI Wholesale and Franchise business. Acting as a central point of coordination between customers and internal stakeholders, the Wholesale Coordinator develops a comprehensive understanding of the market, customer performance, and business opportunities.

Working closely with Sales, Merchandising, Supply Chain, and Finance teams, the role ensures the seamless execution of wholesale operations, provides analytical support, and contributes to delivering an exceptional customer experience across the region.




Key Responsibilities of the role




Business Analysis & Reporting (70%)

Analyze wholesale and franchise customer performance, sell-through, and purchasing trends to identify opportunities and risks.
Prepare and maintain regular reporting tools and dashboards for Wholesale, Merchandising, and senior management teams.
Gather and consolidate customer data to produce weekly and monthly business reviews.
Support preparation for commercial meetings with Women's, Men's, and Leather Goods teams by providing insights and performance analysis.
Monitor key business KPIs and proactively highlight areas requiring attention or action.




Customer & Operational Management (15%)

Support the day-to-day management of wholesale and franchise accounts in partnership with Logistics, Supply Chain, and Finance teams.
Coordinate shipment tracking, delivery performance reporting, and order follow-up activities.
Manage customer-related administrative processes, including sales price lists, markdown files, product information, and commercial documentation.
Act as a key point of contact for customers, ensuring timely responses and effective communication.
Support the sales team with order management, issue resolution, and ongoing account servicing.




Sales Support & Commercial Coordination (10%)

Assist the Wholesale team in preparing seasonal sell-in campaigns, appointments, and customer presentations.
Support the successful execution of product launches, market initiatives, and commercial projects.
Contribute to identifying opportunities to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
Development of marketing tools.




Marketing Tools & Training (5%)

Coordinate the creation and distribution of seasonal lookbooks and sales support materials.
Support the development of training content for internal wholesale teams and external partners.
Ensure product information and brand messaging are communicated consistently across all customer touchpoints.




Skills & Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you will demonstrate the following:

1-2 years of experience in business analysis, data analytics, performance reporting, commercial analysis, or a related analytical environment.
Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Business, Fashion, Retail Management, or a related field.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Fluent in English and French, both written and spoken; Italian is an advantage.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Highly organised, with excellent planning and prioritisation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Proactive, adaptable, and capable of working independently.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and customer-centric mindset.




Our Business and our Values:

Christian Louboutin, created in 1991 in Paris, is a global luxury brand leader when it comes to shoes for women and men and leather goods. Christian Louboutin is also renowned for its iconic red sole, imagined by Mr. Christian Louboutin himself, a year after the creation of the brand. The brand has more than 160 Boutiques in 38 countries featuring the signature shoes such as the iconic pumps, sneakers and loafers alongside the seasonal collections for women, men and accessories. Christian Louboutin imagines collections through a large spectrum of inspirations emanating from his love of Paris, his travels, and his passion for art and craftmanship. 2014 welcomed the launch of Christian Louboutin Beauté with the iconic Rouge Louboutin nail and lip colour.




Our people are at the heart of our brand

We celebrate individuality and allow the freedom to have responsibility, autonomy and creativity within your role. Our colleagues have in common the passion and dedication to our Brand, and its continued success.




We live by our values:

We are down to earth – we stand with authenticity, integrity and respect. We have passion – we drive our business with agility, commitment and care. We have happiness in all that we do – we collaborate with positivity, open-mindedness and fun. We work with inspiration – we envision the future with confidence, creativity and freedom.”




The Maison Christian Louboutin is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to recruitment practices that do not discriminate against any job applicant because of their race, color, gender, age, nationality, culture(s), religion, sex, physical or mental disability, or age. We believe that a culture of diversity and individuality fosters our core values we listed above. So, if you also share this mindset and these values and you dream of coloring your soles red as part of the Louboutin adventure, please join us!




Your personal data is processed by Christian Louboutin following its legitimate interest to manage applications and ensure the efficiency of its recruitment process. To find out more about the processing of your personal data and your rights, please contact the Privacy team at privacyteam@fr.christianlouboutin.com.




If you are interested and have the necessary skills, please send us your application through LinkedIn or at recrutement@ch.christianlouboutin.com. Please note that if you did not hear from us after 3 weeks it means that your application has not been selected.
